exposure: MBRN data on planned mode of delivery
MBRN data on actual mode of delivery
MBRN data on onset of delivery
Algorithm to identify TOL using MBRN data
cohort: The study included 477 women with birth order two deliveries between 1989-2012 who had a registered birth order one CS delivery in Norway, from a random national sample of 500.
finding: An algorithm to identify trial of labor (TOL) using MBRN data had a positive predictive value of 93.2%, a negative predictive value of 93.5%, a sensitivity of 96.1%, and a specificity of 88.8%, indicating satisfactory quality for registry-based studies.
mod_finding: The study's primary focus was validating MBRN data for identifying Trial of Labor (TOL) deliveries and data on mode of delivery after a previous cesarean section, finding the data quality satisfactory.
